subject: Adding ggplot2 geom_line based on input

messages.author: 6c4d187713e325b8
messages.subject: Adding ggplot2 geom_line based on input
parts:
Hi Everyone,
I was wondering how to add Geomlines based on the reactive input. For example, if I have a checkboxGroupInput (below) to select insurance types, how can we add lines to the ggplot based on the selected insurance types. I would also like to be able to add multiple lines for comparison based upon the checkboxGroupInput. On the UI side we could have as below:

                          checkboxGroupInput(inputId = "Model",                                                                               
                                  label = h4("What kind of insurance do you use"),                                                                       
                                  choices = c("Compound" = "Compound", "Simple" = "Simple", 
                                  "Private" = "Private", "Complex" = "Complex"),
                                  selected = "Private"
                                                            )
          
On the server side, I will create the reactive plot using the starter code below, and then I want to be able to add respective lines based on the user selects. 


  output$Mainplot <- renderPlot({                         
     ggplot(df_norm,aes(x=ages)) +     
     # ADD GEOM_LINE HERE
     labs(title="Insurance Models")
                                                })


  
Now for each geom_line,  

 Compound <-     paste("geom_line(aes(y= Compound, colour=' Compound'),size=0.5)", "+")"
 Simple <-            paste("geom_line(aes(y=Simple, colour='Simple'),size=0.5)", "+")"
 Complex <-         paste("geom_line(aes(y=Complex, colour='Complex'),size=0.5)", "+")"
 Private <-            paste("geom_line(aes(y=Private, colour='Private'),size=0.5)", "+")"




Kind Regards,
      Conal
